native_interface: The complete uniform supplier has W productive full-rank-N fields, P paid rank-one children, and P/W<N^sigma. Its complete spectators and arbitrary-input identity include calls on owned centers.

occupied_rows.reserve: q0=ceil(log2W)*D(d) selected-bit row coordinates; complete neighborhood chunks may be retained as spectators.
occupied_rows.padding: Pad the complete row count once to the next multiple ofW^D(d); factor<2. Every descendant has exactly1/W parent productive volume and sufficient divisibility.
occupied_rows.single_integer_meaning: The W arbitrary role inputs are distinct existing row fibers of one coefficient array. Their values may be correlated or zero; no independent productive input is created by copying.
occupied_rows.owned_centers: Each existing owner has its charged bank of the same stream shape; a child can receive correlated owned-center contents, since the identity holds for every assignment to distinct physical slots.
occupied_rows.zero_padding: Independent completed endpoints map appended zero rows back to zero, permitting their removal before the next external diagonal.
occupied_rows.selected_stock_kernels: Reserve kernels are not performed before the active call. After its completed identity-on-stock endpoint, perform their q0 elementary Gaussian kernels, within the same full Gaussian job and before an external diagonal.

consequences: every internal floor child has positive width
validity_threshold.below_d0: Use individual Gaussian axes; their40*p*d charge is absorbed by40*M*d^s when w<=2p.

stopped_tree.threshold: T=ceil(d^beta), with global original selected widthd fixed throughout the tree
stopped_tree.elementary_leaf: c(e)<=40e when e<T; cost normalized by p*(1+rho)*productive_volume and requires w<=2p

all_size_circuit_upper.ordinary_Hadamard_conversion: S=diag(1,i); S^tensor(d) C_d S^tensor(d)=((1+i)/2)^d H_d. Thus H_d uses at most two real ADD and seven NEG macros per coordinate in addition to C_d; division-free fixed shifts cover the collapsed global factor(1-i)^d.
all_size_circuit_upper.V: Number of complex coefficient positions in the original complete coefficient tensor, before the one-time factor<2 row padding.
all_size_circuit_upper.word_guard: w must be sufficient for exact native dyadic arithmetic relative to the incoming common fine grid; apply the new global precision bound to incoming magnitude/denominator andC0*d. No rounding occurs at supplier child returns.
all_size_circuit_upper.no_input_length_identification: d is selected Gaussian-axis count, V is coefficient volume, w is component bit width; none equals integer input lengthn by definition.

all_size_exact_semantic_guard.active_recursion: A(e)<=A(floor(e/N))+P*floor(e/N)+E; elementary leavesA(e)<=8e. ThereforeA(e)<=2*B_constant*e for every permitted stopping threshold.
all_size_exact_semantic_guard.padding_and_repacking: Known zero rows, copying and fixed permutations change neither denominator nor magnitude exponents.
all_size_exact_semantic_guard.stock_completion: Active returned C_(d-q0) has completed magnitude/denominator excess<=d-q0. Ordinary C on q0 stock axes has temporary excess<=8q0; total<=d+7q0<=8d<=2*B_constant*d.
all_size_exact_semantic_guard.C_to_H_conversion: S phases preserve exponents. After completed C_d the collapsed integer Gaussian factor(1-i)^d adds no denominator and at mostd+1 temporary magnitude bits. Total<=2d+1<=3d<=2*B_constant*d for d>=1.
all_size_exact_semantic_guard.conclusion: The entire occupied-row, stopped, all-size C_d or H_d call retains BOTH denominator and temporary-magnitude excess<C0*d relative to its incoming common fine grid and incoming magnitude.

proof_scope: All-size upper for one complete selected-axis canonical Gaussian operation on a single complete array, conditional on the source native identity and stated monomial interface. It is not yet a complete integer multiplication upper or crossover.
